card.desc: Something entering water - a body, an object, a fall.
card.prompt: a heavy object dropped into deep still water once, a hollow low splash, water displaced and closing back over, droplets falling after, close microphone, outdoors
card.negative: music, speech, tonal, rain, waves, reverb
card.note: 'rain, waves' are in the negative or the model gives you a body of water instead of one event - it hears 'water' and renders an ambience. 'deep' and 'still' are doing real work: shallow water is a bright slap with no hollow, and you cannot EQ one into the other.

evidence.method: nothing has checked this card against pixels
